dataset_title: Sentinel-1 Typical Oceanic and Atmospheric Phenomena Semantic Segmentation Dataset
authoritative_citations: Li, Q., Bai, X., Hu, L., Li, L., Bao, Y., Geng, X., & Yan, X.-H. (2025). Semantic Segmentation of Typical Oceanic and Atmospheric Phenomena in SAR Images Based on Modified Segformer. Remote Sensing, 18(1), 113. https://doi.org/10.3390/rs18010113
Li, Q. et al. (2024). SAR Image Semantic Segmentation of Typical Oceanic and Atmospheric Phenomena. Earth System Science Data Discussions, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2024-222 (Preprint)

authoritative_reconciliation_summary.paper_focus: 12 typical oceanic and atmospheric phenomena: AF, OF, RF/RC, IC/IB, SI, POW, WS, LWA, BS, MCC, IWs, Eddy (plus unannotated background seawater BG).
authoritative_reconciliation_summary.zenodo_catalog: Enumerates 15 tags: 1. BG, 2. AF, 3. BS, 4. I/IB, 5. LWA, 6. MCC, 7. OF, 8. POW, 9. RC/RF, 10. SI, 11. WS, 12. Eddy, 13. IW/IWs, 14. HM (artificial objects: ships, wind turbines), 15. OS (mineral oil spill: explicitly flagged as 'insufficient data available for training, which will be supplemented in the future').
authoritative_reconciliation_summary.full_mask_audit_finding: All 5,011 label PNG masks share an identical PASCAL VOC palette. Pixel values span IDs 0 through 14. Class 14 (OS) appears in exactly 4 images (1,702 pixels total, 0.0005% of the dataset), confirming the authors' statement that oil spill data is effectively absent and cannot support model training.
authoritative_reconciliation_summary.scientific_mandate: The Li et al. dataset is strictly an Ocean Phenomena and Look-Alike dataset. It contains NO statistically viable Oil Spill ground truth and must NEVER be used as an oil-spill detection training set.

classes.authoritative_definition: Ambient open-ocean sea surface without discrete identifiable phenomena. Formed by unannotated parts in Labelme JSON files.
classes.source_citation: Zenodo 14279466 Description, Item 1; ESSD Preprint L131

classes.authoritative_definition: Synoptic or mesoscale air-mass boundary causing abrupt wind shift and radar backscatter steps.
Surface-active organic monomolecular films from phytoplankton blooms damping capillary-gravity waves.
Glacial ice masses drifting in subpolar/polar oceans displaying specular corner reflection and radar shadows.
classes.source_citation: Paper Section 2.1; Table 2; Zenodo Item 4 ('I' is equivalent to 'IB')

classes.authoritative_definition: Calm ocean sectors where 10m wind speed < 2.5-3 m/s, extinguishing Bragg resonance and creating large dark backscatter patches.
Atmospheric boundary-layer convective organization forming open/closed polygonal cells (10-50 km) that modulate wind stress.
Water mass density/temperature boundary with current shear and surface convergence collecting surfactants into dark lines.
Regular swell wave trains visible as periodic linear backscatter modulations.
Precipitation downdraft divergence on sea surface creating dark cores surrounded by bright splash rings.
classes.source_citation: Paper Section 2.1; Table 2; Zenodo Item 9 ('RC' is equivalent to 'RF')

classes.authoritative_definition: Frozen seawater (floes, pack ice, grease ice, fast ice) modifying surface permittivity and roughness.
Quasi-parallel linear roughness streaks aligned with wind direction from atmospheric boundary layer roll vortices.
Rotating mesoscale/sub-mesoscale oceanic vortex entraining surfactants along spiraling current shear lines.
Subsurface solitary gravity wave packets on pycnocline creating alternating surface convergence (bright) and divergence (dark slick) bands.
classes.source_citation: Paper Section 2.1; Table 2; Zenodo Item 13 (derived from Tao et al. 2022b)

classes.authoritative_definition: Man-made structures including merchant/fishing vessels, offshore platforms, aquaculture rafts, and wind turbines.
classes.source_citation: Zenodo 14279466 Description, Item 14 (Not included in paper's 12 phenomena evaluation)

classes.authoritative_definition: Hydrocarbon mineral oil releases. Formally disqualified by dataset authors due to insufficient training samples (4 images, 1,702 pixels).
classes.source_citation: Zenodo 14279466 Description, Item 15 ('currently, there is insufficient data available for training, which will be supplemented in the future')
